description: Security mechanisms, service levels, and requirements of network services are not identified and implemented. This signal indicates that network services lack documented security requirements, service level agreements, authentication mechanisms, encryption, or appropriate security controls.
applicability: Applicable to all network services including managed services, cloud services, internet services, internal network services, APIs, third-party network services, and service provider connections. Includes DNS, DHCP, NTP, authentication services, file sharing, messaging, and application services.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of service agreements, network service configurations, security requirements documentation, authentication mechanisms, encryption settings, and service monitoring capabilities. May also be identified through assessment of vendor management processes and service level agreements.
